title: Neso Grande Portable Beach Tent Sun Shelter - Lightweight Beach Shade Canopy - Easy Setup for Family Outings - Patented Reinforced Corners - UPF 50+ Sun Protection - 7ft Tall, 9 x 9ft
features: Beautifully Designed Shade for Every Outing - 7ft Tall, 9 x 9ft Wide - 81 square feet of coverage and a 7-foot peak. Designed for large families, beachgoers, and campers, solve the problem of harsh sun exposure during all-day excursions. Whether you're setting up for a lake day or a picnic, this Neso beach tent provides a cool, breathable retreat with its nylon/lycra blend. It is the perfect solution for anyone needing a reliable beach canopy that is easy to transport and use.

Engineered for Strength, Stability, and Sun Protection: This Neso tent stays secure thanks to rust-proof aluminum poles, patented reinforced corners, and sand anchor bags that eliminate the need for stakes. All our Neso beach shades offer UPF 50+ protection. In fact, no matter the color or print, our sun shades have been tested to provide UPF 185–500—well beyond standard protection. Neso tents have the Seal of Recommendation by the Skin Cancer Foundation.

Lightweight and Portable: At just 6.5 lbs, this lightweight beach tent is easy to carry and pack.It folds into a compact 19.5-inch shoulder bag that fits in a carry-on suitcase for effortless travel—and it’s designed to stay put and perform great in winds up to 20MPH. Plus, the built-in cooler pocket keeps drinks and snacks chilled while you enjoy the coverage of your Neso grande.

An Easy-to-Set-Up Beach Sun Shelter: The simple, two-pole design allows for quick setup in minutes so you can relax and enjoy the day. Effortlessly set up your Neso grande by laying it flat, filling the anchor bags with sand or rocks, extending the bags in an "X" for full fabric stretch, and propping up the tent with poles for robust stability. For detailed guidance, please refer to our comprehensive step-by-step instruction manual.

We Got You Covered: Neso is committed to designing innovative, portable, and lightweight products for your next sunny adventure. Our team is united in our love of the outdoors and shares a commitment to taking care of our bodies and our planet, and most importantly we understand time with our families is precious.
